documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited reported stellar operational and financial performance for Q4 and full year FY26, achieving highest-ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT (112% of installed capacity) and highest-ever distillate yield of 79.1%. The company's gross refining margin (GRM) for FY26 stood at $9.2 per barrel compared to Singapore benchmark of $5.83 per barrel, while Q4 GRM was $13.75 per barrel. Management highlighted a strong balance sheet with a net debt-to-equity ratio of 0.09 and announced a total dividend of INR62 per equity share for the year. Moving forward, the company is progressing on its Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project of INR1,600 crores and a retail outlet project of INR400 crores. Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited reported its Q4 FY25 financial and operational performance, highlighting strong physical output with crude throughput at 113% of installed capacity during the quarter.

guidance.claim: Management expects the maintenance capex for the next year to remain in the range of Rs. 200-250 crore.
guidance.quote: Our maintenance CAPEX remains Rs. 200-250 crore range, and the next year forecast also, we feel the CAPEX will be in that range.

guidance.claim: The company expects higher throughput in operational terms for the financial year 2025-26 compared to last year.
guidance.quote: So, you can expect a throughput which is higher than last year on the operational part.

demand_outlook.claim: Motor Spirit (MS) in the southern market shows a clear shortfall where production is less than demand.
demand_outlook.quote: MS in southern market, there is a clear shortfall so, the production is less than demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Motor Spirit demand growth projection in the southern market is around 4%-5%.
demand_outlook.quote: Like MS, they are projecting 6% and here we see around 4%-5%.

demand_outlook.claim: High-Speed Diesel (HSD) growth forecast in the southern market is seen at 3%.
demand_outlook.quote: HSD we see at 3% growth forecast, as against 2.5% odd here.

capex_expansion.claim: The company stated that the Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project is valued at INR1,600 crores and the retail outlet project at INR400 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: LOBS project, Group 2, Group 3 LOBS project is INR1,600 crores. The retail outlet project is INR400 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project approvals are in place and execution has started in full swing.
capex_expansion.quote: Some of the important projects that we'll be taking up is Group 2, Group 3 LOBS for which all approvals are in place and the project execution has started in full swing.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that normal capex is around INR500 crores every year.
capex_expansion.quote: Besides, every year, you can assume another INR500 crores is our normal capex.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that retail outlet commissioning will be seen during the financial year 2026-27.
capex_expansion.quote: And this year, that is '26-'27, we'll see a lot of commissioning out of them.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL spent Rs. 673 crores as capex for the current year.
capex_expansion.quote: On the CAPEX front, in the current year, we have spent Rs. 673 crores as CAPEX for the current year.

capex_expansion.claim: The revised capital cost for the CBR project stands at Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian Oil.
capex_expansion.quote: The revised capital cost is at Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian oil respectively.

capex_expansion.claim: The new refinery project has a capacity of 9 million metric tons and a petrochemical intensity of 6% for polypropylene.
capex_expansion.quote: The new refinery capital cost is Rs 36,000 Crore approximately, 9 million metric ton capacity and petrochemical intensity of 6% and which is PP, polypropylene.

margins_costs.claim: The gross refining margin for quarter 4 was $13.75 per barrel compared to the Singapore benchmark of $8.70 per barrel.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for quarter 4 was $13.75 barrel as compared to Singapore benchmark of $8.70 per barrel, which again reiterates that all these efficiencies are constant, continuous and are being sustained over each period.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the core GRM for Q4 was $10.3 per barrel.
Management stated that forex losses for the quarter were approximately INR200 crores and around INR350 crores for the whole year.
margins_costs.quote: For the quarter, it would be for the quarter, it is approximately INR 200 crores,. And for the whole year, it will be around INR350 crores.

margins_costs.claim: The Gross Refining Margin (GRM) for FY 2024-25 was $4.22 per barrel compared to $8.64 per barrel in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for 2024-25 for a full year basis is $4.22 per barrel as compared to the previous year $8.64 per barrel, but if you compare it to Singapore benchmark which was $3.79 per barrel in the current year, we have performed better.

margins_costs.claim: For the fourth quarter, the Gross Refining Margin was $6.22 per barrel.
margins_costs.quote: On Quarter 4, our GRM was $6.22 per barrel.

margins_costs.claim: Inventory gain for the fourth quarter was $0.66 per barrel, amounting to Rs. 125 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory gain is not very significant for the quarter. It is only $ 0.66 per barrel. And in absolute rupee terms, it is Rs. 125 crores only.

margins_costs.claim: The fuel and loss for the year as a whole came down to 8.51%.
margins_costs.quote: and in that context, the fuel and loss has come down to 8.51% for the year as a whole.

margins_costs.claim: Inventory on a full-year basis recorded a loss of $0.06 per barrel or Rs. 40 crores.
margins_costs.quote: But on an overall annual basis, the inventory would be a loss that is $ 0.06 per barrel, Rs. 40 crores in amount.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 million metric tons, equivalent to 112% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT, million metric ton, which equivalents to 112% of installed capacity, breaking records of our previous best of 11.64 MMT achieved in financial year 2023-'24.

orders_capacity.claim: Crude throughput in quarter 4 was 2.93 MMT, which is 111% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: In quarter 4 of the current financial year, CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 2.93 MMT, which is also 111% of installed capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The new Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS unit will add a capacity of 250,000 KTPA.
orders_capacity.quote: My new unit will take me to a 250,000, 250 KTPA in Group 2, Group 3 capacity, and that will be a fresh addition.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the pharma-grade Hexane capacity has been doubled from 30 to 60.
orders_capacity.quote: It was 30, now the capacity is 60.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT, equivalent to 99.5% of installed capacity during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT, equivalent to 99.5% of our installed capacity

orders_capacity.claim: The Manali Refinery has an installed capacity of 10.5 MMTPA.

capital_allocation.claim: The gross borrowings stand at INR1,900 crores and net borrowings at INR973 crores, resulting in a net debt-to-equity ratio of 0.09.
capital_allocation.quote: On a gross basis, the borrowings are INR1,900 crores, but on a net basis, it is less than INR1,000 crores, to be precise, INR973 crores. If we consider net borrowing, the debt ratio is only 0.09, which is less than 0.1.

capital_allocation.claim: Capex during the financial year was INR856 crores compared to INR673 crores in the previous year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the current year, the capex was INR856 crores as compared to INR673 crores in the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: Total debt at an absolute level stands at Rs. 3,100 crores as on March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: At an absolute level, the debt stands at Rs. 3,100 crores as compared to Rs. 2,762 crores as on March 31, 2024.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share, representing 50% of the face value for the current year.
capital_allocation.quote: With the above, the Board has also recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share that is 50% of face value for the current year and as we all know, this is subject to approval at AGM, which will happen in the due course.

capital_allocation.claim: Net worth is reported at Rs. 7,939 crores as on March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Net worth is at Rs. 7,939 crores as on March 31, 2025.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that uncertainties due to logistical constraints and volatility of crude oil prices pose challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: Now with all this, I would like to say the uncertainties due to logistical constraints, volatility of crude oil prices do pose challenges.

risks_headwinds.claim: Uncertainties due to the volatility of crude prices pose a challenge to operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Finally, the uncertainties due to volatility of crude prices do pose a challenge.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the INR2,000 crores capex for LOBS and retail outlets will happen over 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: This INR2,000 crores will happen over 2 to 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that they do not see any maintenance and inspection in the first 6 months.
management_commitments.quote: First, reply to you , in the first 6 months, we don't see any M&I.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that a scheduled maintenance and inspection of one of the refinery units is scheduled close to September or October.
management_commitments.quote: So it may not be there. But yes, maybe close to September, October, we have a scheduled M&I of one of our refinery units.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the ongoing study for low-cost debottlenecking is expected to be completed in the coming financial year '26-'27.
management_commitments.quote: But in the coming year, '26-'27, we hope that ongoing study will get completed.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that on a sustained basis, they will bring fuel and loss indexes down to very efficient levels.
management_commitments.quote: we went to a roadmap where we said on a sustained basis, we will bring it down to very efficient levels

management_commitments.claim: CPCL is committed to developing new schemes on energy efficiency, taking the fuel and loss reduction roadmap further lower, and developing enhanced production of value-added products.
management_commitments.quote: To summarize the physical performance, we are committed to develop new schemes on energy efficiency, take the fuel and loss reduction roadmap further lower and then develop enhanced production of value-added products as well going forward.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
